name: Bruggerhof
beschreibung: The Bruggerhof in Kitzbühel is a campsite in Tirol. It offers pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern. A small shop and a restaurant are available on the grounds. The site is located near the center of Kitzbühel. From here, the Kitzbüheler Alpen can be used for tours. The Bruggerhof is open all year round and has a playground.
